name: The Ore That Lifts

levels.entry: Black rock in the island's flank. Grit from it does not lie down; it stands on end and points.
It points the same way here as it does on the far island, and neither way is north.
A knife laid on the face will not lie flat. Held above it, it is lighter than it is in my hand.
The whole island is this. Not standing on it -- made of it, all the way through, which is why the edges crumble and the middle does not.
So the island is held up by what it is made of, and the ore weighs less the more of it there is together. I have written that down twice and it is still what the measurements say.

notes: Aravali. Deliberately unresolved at the last rung -- the diary describes exactly and refuses to guess, which is the discipline this game is about.
